definition: A prison, especially one intended for long-term confinement.
author: Mark Twain
quote: For if it hadn’t been for that, they’d a jailed us till them Englishmen’s baggage come—and then—the penitentiary, you bet!
example_sentence: Revising in the library all week felt like a stretch in the penitentiary.
